jobs.description: Do you have a valid Dutch work permit and do you have experience operating a forklift or reach truck? Then this position is for you. You will work in an open and pleasant working environment where teamwork and accuracy are key. In addition, you have the chance of a contract upon good performance. Read on!Employment agency Manpower is looking for Forklift Drivers / Reach Truck Drivers for Arvato in Heijen.As a forklift or reach truck driver, you will work in different departments within the warehouse, such as inbound, assembly and outbound. This keeps your tasks varied and diverse.Your tasks include:    - Receiving, inspecting, and scanning goods and pallets    - Moving, palletizing, and processing goods using a forklift    - Picking orders for assembly and shipment    - Packing, labeling, and preparing orders for dispatch    - Loading trucks according to loading schedules    - Identifying discrepancies and reporting malfunctions    - Performing general warehouse duties using forklifts and reach trucksWhat's in it for you    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour    - Temporary contract via Manpower with the chance of being hired directly upon good performance    - Pension accrual via Manpower    - Travel allowance according to the employer’s policy    - Possibility to work 32 to 40 hours per week    - Shift allowance or overtime compensation (when applicable)    - A varied position within a modern logistics working environment📦    - In possession of a forklift or reach truck certificate    - Good command of the English language    - Reliable and honest, able to keep agreements    - Flexible regarding working hours and overtime    - Able to work accurately with attention to detail    - Proactive and willing to help colleagues when needed    - Good physical condition and no physical complaints    - Willing to apply for a Certifica
